titleEn: Delta Kitchen Renovation Cost 2026: Real BC Project Example
titleZh: 三角洲廚房裝修造價：真實BC省案例與2026最新報價
contentEn:
This Delta kitchen was rebuilt in white shaker cabinetry with a quartz waterfall peninsula and a matching full-height counter run. A deep apron-front sink sits under the window with brushed brass tapware, and a stacked tile backsplash carries the light finish behind the range and hood. Oak-toned plank flooring runs through the space. The same project renewed the bathroom, where a soft grey vanity with a black-framed mirror faces a marble-look tiled tub surround.

For Delta homeowners comparing contractors in 2026, this project illustrates what a full kitchen-and-bath renewal actually costs in the municipality — and why a single coordinated job can outperform two separate cosmetic refreshes.

What Made This Delta Kitchen Renovation Distinct

The client wanted a kitchen that could host family gatherings without feeling dark or dated. The renovation removed a soffit above the stove area, opened the sightline to the dining nook, and daylight from the window above the apron sink now reaches all the way to the back wall. Shaker-profile doors in off-white were specified throughout — the builder matched door reveal depth to the existing cabinet box so the new fronts sat flush without replacing the carcases. A quartz waterfall peninsula at the island adds a strong material contrast against the white and provides seating for four without a separate table in the galley layout. Brushed brass bin pulls and a gooseneck bridge faucet complete the hardware palette without introducing a finish that shows water spots. The stacked subway tile behind the range is a deliberate continuity move: it extends the same material from the range wall to the window wall so the whole cooking zone reads as a single composed surface rather than a patchwork of product choices.

Full Renovation Cost per Square Foot in Delta, BC — 2026

Full-scope kitchen renovation in Delta (cabinetry replacement, new countertops, plumbing rerouting, electrical rework, flooring and finishes) runs $180–$280 per square foot as of early 2026. Basic refresh (cabinet door replacement, new laminate countertops, updated hardware) typically runs $65–$110 per square foot — lower upfront cost but with limited structural upgrade value. Delta market sits below Vancouver city centre but above Fraser Valley同类工程平均水平。

同期浴室翻新（浴室柜更换，新浴缸区、瓷砖工程、照明升级及通风改善）为合同增加约$18,000–$28,000——作为独立房间计算但由同一团队协调安排，以减少差旅费用和前期工程重叠。

Delta Project Timeline

The kitchen phase from demolition to cabinet installation practical completion took 9 working days. countertops were measured on day 5; installed on day 11. The bathroom phase ran concurrently during the countertop lead time, finishing 2 days after kitchen practical completion. Total from start to full handover: 13 working days.

Why Bundle Kitchen and Bathroom Under One Contract

For budget-conscious Delta homeowners, combining contracts reduces the per-square-foot premium on both spaces. A renovation company's indirect costs — site setup, waste removal, permit coordination — are spread across both spaces rather than charged twice. Countertop, bathroom hardware and tile lead times run concurrently, so the overall timeline extends only marginally beyond a single-room job. 聚星装修一个项目经理和一份许可证申请管理两个空间，简化验收流程并减少各工种之间的范围缺口。

If your Delta home needs a kitchen refresh and your bathroom is also dated, a combined quote often delivers better value than separate arrangements — especially when both are on the same floor and share plumbing runs.
contentZh:
這套三角洲廚房以白色Shaker櫃體重建，配石英石瀑布半島與同款通體台面。窗下設置深型Farmhouse水槽，搭配拉絲黃銅龍頭；瓷磚擋水牆延續淺色調，由灶台延伸至窗牆，視覺一氣呵成。空間通鋪橡木色地板。同期還翻新了衛生間：淺灰色浴室櫃配黑框鏡，對面為仿大理石瓷磚浴缸區。

對正在比較2026年承包商的三角洲業主而言，這個項目展示了在該市進行全面廚房與浴室翻新工程實際造價，以及為何一次協調施工可勝過兩次獨立裝修。

本項目與眾不同之處

客戶希望打造一個能舉辦家庭聚會、又不顯昏暗過時的廚房。工程拆除灶台上方的壁柱，開通至餐區的視線； apron sink上方的窗戶引入的日光現在可直接照射到後牆。啞光白色Shaker門板全屋統一規格——建築商比對門板深度與現有櫃體，使新門板無縫嵌入而不需更換整體框架。石英石瀑布半島的吧台區域提供四人座位，在走廊式格局中無需另行擺放餐桌。拉絲黃銅拉手和鵝頸橋式龍頭完成五金配置，且不引入易留水漬的表面處理。疊砌地鐵磚位於灶台區——同一材料由灶台牆延伸至窗牆，使整個烹飪區形成統一構圖而非零散產品組合。

三角洲BC省全面裝修造價每平方英尺——2026年

2026年初，三角洲全面廚房裝修（櫃體更換、新台面、管道改線、水電改造、地板及飾面）造價為每平方英尺180至280加元。基礎翻新（僅更換門板，新層壓板台面和新五金）通常為每平方英尺65至110加元——前期成本較低但結構升級價值有限，三城市場低於溫哥華市區但高於菲沙谷同類工程平均水平。

同期浴室翻新（浴室櫃更換，新浴缸區、瓷磚工程、照明升級及通風改善）為合同增加約18,000至28,000加元——作為獨立房間計算但由同一團隊協調安排，以減少差旅費用和前期工程重疊。

三角洲工程時間表

廚房階段從拆除至櫃體安裝實際完工共9個工作日。台面量尺在第5個工作日；台面安裝在第11個工作日。浴室階段在等待台面期間同步進行，於廚房實際完工後2天完成。從開工到全面移交總工期：13個工作日。

為何將廚房與浴室納入同一合同

對有預算考慮的三角洲業主而言，合併合同可降低兩個空間的每平方英尺溢價。翻新公司的間接成本——工地設置、廢物處理、許可證協調——分攤至兩個空間而非雙重收費。台面、衛生間五金和瓷磚的交貨周期並行安排，總工期僅略微延長於單房工程。聚星裝修一個項目經理和一份許可證申請管理兩個空間，簡化驗收流程並減少各工種之間的範圍缺口。

若您的三角洲住宅需要廚房翻新且浴室已顯老舊，合併報價通常比分開安排更具性價比——尤其是兩者位於同一層且共用水管的情況。
